title: Template v2.1 template_project validation: preflight → run → verify (tol + strict)
abstract: Runs the shared template_project using Template v2.1 tools: preflight, run (env capture + entrypoint), verify (tolerance), create strict config via hashing, verify (strict). Prints a concise JSON summary.

original_submission.content:
import os, sys, json, subprocess

BASE = "storage/shared/agency_lab/repro_template/v2"
PROJ = f"{BASE}/template_project"

def run_cmd(cmd, cwd=None):
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print("STDOUT:", p.stdout)
        print("STDERR:", p.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
    out = p.stdout.strip()
    try:
        return json.loads(out)
    except Exception:
        return {"raw": out}

def main():
    # Run entirely inside the template project directory
    cfg = "verify_config.json"
    # 1) Preflight (static checks)
    pref = run_cmd([sys.executable, f"{BASE}/preflight_static.py", "--config", cfg], cwd=PROJ)
    # 2) Run (env capture + entrypoint 'python run_task.py')
    run_out = run_cmd([sys.executable, f"{BASE}/run.py", "--config", cfg, "--cwd", "."], cwd=PROJ)
    # 3) Verify (with tolerance)
    ver_tol = run_cmd([sys.executable, f"{BASE}/verify.py", "--mode", "with-tolerance", "--config", cfg], cwd=PROJ)
    # 4) Hash outputs → strict config
    hash_out = run_cmd([sys.executable, f"{BASE}/hash_outputs.py", "--config", cfg, "--out", "verify_config.strict.json"], cwd=PROJ)
    # 5) Verify (strict)
    ver_strict = run_cmd([sys.executable, f"{BASE}/verify.py", "--mode", "strict", "--config", "verify_config.strict.json"], cwd=PROJ)

    print(json.dumps({
        "preflight": pref,
        "run": run_out,
        "verify_tolerance": ver_tol,
        "hash_outputs": hash_out,
        "verify_strict": ver_strict
    }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
